expansion_contract.fact_row: verified official-source, canonical-state, workflow-evidence or acceptance-contract fact
expansion_contract.boundary_row: prevents general open-data rights, website reproduction rights, checker models, address-index refreshes, publication cadence or local-authority performance products from being promoted to exact January 2026 postcode or parcel coverage without accepted r2 bytes and hardened postjoin evidence

facts.detail: The terminal heartbeat has no active owner lease.
No active or over-15-minute PENDING execution exists.

guard_streams.write_limit: No second task, owner takeover or parallel runner is permitted.

facts.detail: The exact 11,013-row output JSONL remains empty.
The source snapshot remains exact_rows_returned zero and source_scan_complete remains false.

guard_streams.write_limit: No candidate or 3/4 promotion before exact r2 and hardened postjoin acceptance.

facts.detail: Ofcom defines open data as data that anyone can access, use or share.
Ofcom open data can include information from regulated communications companies and from citizens and consumers.

guard_streams.write_limit: A general open-data classification does not establish that every Connected Nations field is unrestricted or exact.

facts.detail: All data made available on Ofcom websites or other portals is subject to a licence.
Where Ofcom can release data on an open basis it uses the Open Government Licence, subject to its conditions.

guard_streams.write_limit: The licence attached to the exact dataset remains authoritative.

facts.detail: Some released data has use limitations where some or all of it is owned by a third party.
Ofcom states that the applicable licence defines the exact basis on which such data may be used.

guard_streams.write_limit: Third-party restrictions must not be silently replaced by generic OGL assumptions.

facts.detail: Ofcom points users to the statistical release calendar for the current year's data publications.
Datasets may also be available from their parent publication pages and the data.gov.uk portal.

guard_streams.write_limit: A catalogue entry is discovery evidence, not byte-level archive acceptance.

facts.detail: The official open-data page records a last update of 23 June 2026.
Ofcom asks dataset-specific queries to identify the dataset and include relevant links.

guard_streams.write_limit: Page freshness does not prove that a previously downloaded binary is the corrected r2 archive.

facts.detail: Website and hard-copy material is owned by Ofcom or licensed to Ofcom and protected by intellectual-property rights.
The Ofcom logo is a registered trademark and reproduction requires permission.

guard_streams.write_limit: Source data attribution must not imply permission to reuse protected branding.

facts.detail: Unless otherwise indicated, material may be reproduced free of charge if reproduced accurately and not used in a misleading context.
Reproduction must acknowledge Ofcom copyright and specify the document or publication title.

guard_streams.write_limit: Website reproduction permission does not override dataset-specific conditions or exact-join validation.

facts.detail: The mobile checker uses Ordnance Survey data for the UK property-address dataset.
That property dataset is updated in the checker three times a year, so new properties may be absent between updates.

guard_streams.write_limit: A missing checker address is not proof of no coverage or an invalid postcode.

facts.detail: Ofcom provides an API based on its mobile coverage data.
The FAQ states that the API uses the same mobile data that powers the checker.

guard_streams.write_limit: Checker/API equivalence for mobile data cannot substitute for the fixed all-premises r2 ZIP.

facts.detail: Mobile coverage is based on operator predictions generated by computer programs that simulate signal travel and obstruction.
The current checker processes predictions into a 50 metre by 50 metre matrix covering UK landmass.

guard_streams.write_limit: A current checker grid must not be conflated with historical 100 metre publication pixels or fixed-postcode rows.

facts.detail: Connected Nations is currently published twice a year.
The main report is normally released near year-end with an interim update in spring.

guard_streams.write_limit: Publication cadence cannot establish which archive revision is present locally.

facts.detail: Fixed broadband and mobile are supplied as separate downloads, with speed information available only for fixed broadband.
Fixed coverage accompanies each release, fixed performance is annual, and mobile coverage is a separate product family.

guard_streams.write_limit: Metrics must remain within their declared product family and publication cycle.

guard_streams.source: Connected Nations FAQs, Ofcom terms and canonical workflow evidence

facts.detail: Ofcom states that the revised collection is robust for average download speeds down to local-authority level but not postcode level, so no fixed-performance postcode file is published from 2024 onward.
No parcel candidate, measured-speed or accuracy promotion was made; completion still requires exact r2 archive, join and hardened postjoin PASS evidence.

guard_streams.write_limit: Local-authority average performance cannot be downscaled to postcode or parcel values.
